items.title: Improv Ísland
items.why: These shows are weekly and always very entertaining. A super talented group with a guest star. Definitely recommend checking it out!

items.title: Moulin Rouge! Söngleikurinn
items.why: There is a reason why this show is always sold out. The actors are phenomenal, the music and story are beautiful. You won't want to miss out on this!
